UiWidgetBundle.description: Generic, caller-driven list of proposed next steps / next best actions for HXL rendering in Agentforce and MCP channels. The agent supplies the steps as a JSON spec (via NextStepsAction / Get Next Steps); the action normalizes them into an ordered, typed steps[] so the card binds with plain forEach only. Serves meeting follow-ups, deal action plans, onboarding checklists, service resolution paths, and advisor next-best-actions.
